content: Online forecasting baselines. Next, we consider simpler approaches for making forecasts as the conversations happen (i.e., in an online fashion). First, we propose Cumulative BoW, a model that recomputes bag-of-words features on all comments seen thus far every time a new comment arrives. While this approach does exhibit the desired behavior of producing updated predictions for each new comment, it fails to account for relationships between comments.
